about: Reading faces over the 250,000-byte gzipped budget, each held to its measured size (scripts/perf/readingFaces.ts, row reading-face-html of scripts/run-perf-budgets.ts). A recorded face fails when it grows past its size; an unrecorded face fails over 250,000. The budget is not raised. First measured on a build of 54c8cbf4 on 2026-09-26; relativity's German, English and parallel faces and light quanta's parallel face re-measured on a build of 9f3c915d the same day, gzip level 9, the random build id blanked (dispatch 254); light quanta's parallel face re-measured on a build of f27080a9 the same day, after its inline formulas were drawn in colour (dispatch 272).

faces.reason: The whole German text of relativity, 31 printed pages, with 98 coloured printed displays and their term chips. React's flight data carries the page's element tree a second time for hydration: 182 kB of the 305 kB measured on live 0c6777c7. TanElk ruled (mail 40857) that the reading faces stay whole-paper, for find-in-page across the paper, and are not cut. Was 352933; re-measured on a build of 9f3c915d on 2026-09-26 (TanElk), after reader features that add weight to the German, English and parallel faces: the three German faces on their source blocks (8b1cbcb8), the printed page turns marked in the text (7f464ab8), footnotes opening with their printed marks (e857018e), the 1905 misprints marked (288332c9, 9c6500bf) and noted under their displays (9f8f278f), and the period-word notes (943e59da, 5f9aaaec, 73a0563a). Recorded at the measured size rather than cut, since each is text or navigation a reader uses; the budget is not raised.
